caption:
Japan's first winter light-up began in Sapporo, and until Christmas it comes with a Christmas market ✨❄️

🥇 Munich Christmas Market · 20 Nov–25 Dec 2026

🍷 Glühwein, hot chocolate and Sapporo beer, plus a yearly mug with a new design.

🥨 Sausages, pretzels and roasted almonds in the food block, Odori 2-chome.

🤝 Sapporo and Munich are sister cities; the market began in 2002.

🥈 Sapporo White Illumination · Odori Park until 25 Dec 2026

💡 This is its 46th year; it began in 1981 with about 1,000 bulbs.

🌳 Minami 1-jo alone has about 70,000 LEDs on 46 ginkgo trees.

✨ New this year: the old Red Brick Office, lit in blue.

❄️ After Christmas, the street venues stay lit into February and March 2027.

Eat at the huts first, then walk the park after the stalls close, when the crowds thin out. Every venue and date is in our bio 👆 or DM us ODORI.

👫 Send this to whoever you'd drink hot wine in the snow with.
